about: How a suggested person is filed: one table, fed to the server (tests/test_person_filing_table.py: Apply All of a real photo with real ExifTool) and to the page (tests/frontend/person-filing-table.test.mjs: a click on the suggestion's chip). The page's rule is resolveTagOrPerson (web/tagpup/tags.js); the server's is tagpup.core.vocabulary.person_tag, expressed once. `roots` are the tree's roots (has_face 1 holds people), `paths` the nodes below them, `file` the keywords the photo's file holds, `known` the people the library knows (the page's /api/people). `expect`: the tag written (the person added to `file`), "already" (the file names the person: nothing is written), or "ask" (the page asks which people folder; the server leaves the name as it is).
